verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair privacy-posture question for any SaaS that handles user sessions, so the axis applies. The pack contains no AI-training policy or opt-out. 'Privacy mode' and the peer-to-peer connection claim are adjacent privacy features, not a control over AI model training, and 'no training required' refers to user onboarding.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
